calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS rate,
       MAX(r.n) AS max_returns_per_line
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH sl AS (
    SELECT f.*, s.format, s.store_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT 'dup receipt+line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM sl GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web status ' || COALESCE(w.status,'none'), COUNT(*) FROM sl LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = sl.receipt_id WHERE sl.format='Web' GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines w/o order', COUNT(*) FROM sl LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = sl.receipt_id WHERE sl.format='Web' AND w.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff lines', COUNT(*) FROM sl WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg/zero net', COUNT(*) FROM sl WHERE net_amount <= 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_loaded distinct dates', COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) FROM sl;

WITH sl AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT 'refund > net' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sl JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net > sl.net_amount + 0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'qty returned > sold', COUNT(*) FROM sl JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.quantity_returned > sl.quantity
UNION ALL SELECT 'return before sale', COUNT(*) FROM sl JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date < sl.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'return gap > 30d', COUNT(*) FROM sl JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date > sl.sale_date + 30
UNION ALL SELECT 'max return date', CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM MAX(r.return_date)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) FROM sl JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan returns (all time)', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup return_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns on test/999 sales in period', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test');

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT s.format, SUM(x.net_amount) AS lines_net
  FROM fact_sales_line x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = x.product_key
  WHERE x.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
c AS (
  SELECT st.format, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = r.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM f FULL JOIN c USING (format) ORDER BY 1;
